subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------SPT.GH.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-11. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'To understand the reality position of black creativity is to view the significance of "extended functionalism" — which is to say, any attempt to accurately comment on the music must imply some real understanding of the "reality of extended functionalism."' The crossing diagrams how alternative-functionalism structurally meets spiritual-growth at the extended-functionalism scale: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism — the actual working alternative-functioning of black-creative music) crossed with SPT-GH (spiritual growth). ALT-FT sits at the bottom-center with the subject-arrow; SPT-GH sits at upper-left as partner-axis. INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) drops from the main line and carries ATTN (attraction), which carries MOT-DY. TRS (transition) branches up to the right and carries POL-DY (political dynamics), which carries SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics), which carries LG-EXT (logical extension). PART (participation) branches to the right and carries PER-DY (perception dynamics) and INFO-DY (information dynamics), which carries AF-NT (affinity nature).
